metrics.measurement: Instance precision TP/(TP+FP) and recall TP/(TP+FN), by email/name/number/password/face; frozen IoU and matching rules.
metrics.diagnostic_note: 100 external synthetic raster screens / 810 selected PII regions: zero UltraFace predictions. Cross-taxonomy localization recall 0, precision undefined; not general PII classifier or face accuracy.
metrics.latest_diagnostic_note: External OCR/NER diagnostic marks 568/1433 expected PII value tokens. These are grouped exact-token matches, not instance precision/recall; some annotation values are not painted.

metrics.measurement: PII pixel coverage and non-PII preservation reported separately; conservative reconstruction must count useful removed pixels as utility loss.

metrics.latest_diagnostic_note: External local text preview retains 219 exact annotated sensitive tokens on 58/100 screens. Intended-redraw diagnostic only; arbitrary-text export rejected.

metrics.measurement: Cold/warm WASM load, inference p50/p95, downloaded bytes, JS/WASM memory where measurable, CPU/long tasks on recorded device.

metrics.latest_diagnostic_note: External OCR/NER 100-screen processing p95 2888.4ms; 102 main-page long tasks total 35190ms. Worker/process memory and CPU remain unmeasured.

metrics.measurement: User trigger to verified correct end-state, including capture, model, network and action; report human review separately without omitting it from full time.
